descriptions.introduction: Get started with Hyvor Blogs, a privacy-friendly blogging platform with built-in SEO, multi-language support, custom domains, themes, and a headless API.
descriptions.writing: Learn how to write and publish your first post in Hyvor Blogs: posts vs. pages, post status, scheduling, auto-saving, post history, and multi-language posts.
descriptions.editor: Use the Hyvor Blogs rich text editor: inline styles, blocks, links, anchors, images, and code to write and format blog posts faster.
descriptions.suggestionMode: Review and suggest edits to blog posts with Suggestion Mode in Hyvor Blogs. Collaborate with editors and track changes before publishing.
descriptions.seoAnalyzer: Improve your blog post SEO with the Hyvor Blogs SEO Analyzer. Get rule-based suggestions on titles, meta descriptions, headings, keywords, and content.
descriptions.linkAnalyzer: Find broken, redirected, and risky links while you write. The Hyvor Blogs Link Analyzer checks internal and external links in every blog post.
descriptions.themes: Change your blog theme or edit theme files in Hyvor Blogs. Choose from pre-built themes like Hello, customize them, or build your own custom theme.
descriptions.themesOverview: Build a custom Hyvor Blogs theme with Twig, SCSS, and JavaScript. Learn the theme structure, local development workflow, and official theme repository.
descriptions.themesTemplates: Learn how Hyvor Blogs Twig templates work: routes, template files, includes, inheritance, and the variables and filters available in your blog theme.
descriptions.themesStyling: Style your Hyvor Blogs theme with SCSS. Organize chunked CSS files, use the required index.scss, and keep your blog theme easy to customize.
descriptions.themesScripts: Add JavaScript to your Hyvor Blogs theme. Learn how to create asset scripts, link them in templates, and load non-essential scripts asynchronously.
descriptions.themesInternationalization: Make your Hyvor Blogs theme translatable. Learn how to define language files (YAML), translate template strings, and support multi-language blogs.
descriptions.themesConfig: Make your Hyvor Blogs theme configurable with config.yaml. Let bloggers change colors, fonts, and features without editing any theme code.
descriptions.themesPublishing: Publish your custom theme to the Hyvor Blogs theme list. Fork the themes repository, follow the requirements, and submit a pull request.
descriptions.agent: Use the Hyvor Blogs AI agent to review and improve your blog posts. Learn about features, supported providers and models, document changes, and pricing.
descriptions.customDomain: Set up a custom domain for your blog (blog.example.com or example.com) in Hyvor Blogs. Configure DNS records, SSL, and Cloudflare for your own branded blog.
descriptions.subdirectory: Host your blog in a subdirectory like example.com/blog for better SEO. Hyvor Blogs supports Docker, web frameworks, and reverse proxies such as NGINX and Cloudflare.
descriptions.headless: Use Hyvor Blogs as a headless CMS. Manage content in Hyvor Blogs and render it with Next.js, SvelteKit, Astro, or a mobile app using the Data API.
descriptions.hyvorTalk: Add privacy-first comments to your blog with the Hyvor Talk integration in Hyvor Blogs. Connect, embed, and manage comments without leaving your console.
descriptions.hyvorPost: Add a newsletter to your blog with the Hyvor Post integration in Hyvor Blogs. Embed signup forms and send issues to subscribers from your blog console.
descriptions.languages: Create a multi-language blog with Hyvor Blogs. Set the primary language, add languages, translate posts, data, and your theme, and get multilingual SEO right.
descriptions.users: Add users to your Hyvor Blogs blog and assign roles. Learn about the five user roles and the permissions for writing, editing, and managing a blog.
descriptions.tags: Organize blog posts with tags in Hyvor Blogs. Create and assign tags, use tag index pages and private tags, and group similar posts for readers and SEO.
descriptions.media: Manage images and files in the Hyvor Blogs Media Library. Learn about automatic WebP conversion, responsive images (srcset), and image best practices for fast blogs.
descriptions.fonts: Change your blog fonts in Hyvor Blogs. Use built-in Bunny Fonts for GDPR-friendly loading or add custom fonts served from your own domain.
descriptions.seo: Hyvor Blogs handles technical SEO for you: meta tags, hreflang language variants, rich schema, canonical URLs, robots.txt, sitemap, and how to prevent indexing.
descriptions.navigationLinks: Add navigation links to your blog header and footer in Hyvor Blogs. Create, reorder, and customize menu links from the console settings.
descriptions.redirects: Set up 301 and 302 redirects on your blog with Hyvor Blogs. Create static and dynamic regex redirects to keep SEO when you move or rename URLs.
descriptions.customCode: Add custom HTML, CSS, or JavaScript to your blog head and foot with Hyvor Blogs. Integrate analytics and third-party scripts using Twig-enabled code.
descriptions.routes: Customize blog URLs with routes in Hyvor Blogs. Learn the default routes, change post and page permalinks, and map paths to Twig template files.
descriptions.syntaxHighlighting: Highlight code in blog posts with Hyvor Blogs. Server-side syntax highlighting with line numbers, line highlighting, diffs, and focus, no JavaScript needed.
descriptions.webhooks: Get notified when events happen on your blog. Hyvor Blogs webhooks send HTTP requests to your endpoint with request format, security signatures, and retries.
descriptions.apiConsole: Automate blog management with the Hyvor Blogs Console API. Authenticate with an API key to manage posts, tags, media, and settings over HTTP.
descriptions.apiDelivery: The Hyvor Blogs Delivery API tells your server how to serve a blog request. Required for subdirectory hosting; includes endpoint, request, and response details.
descriptions.apiData: Use the Hyvor Blogs Data API to fetch public blog data (posts, tags, authors) as JSON. No API key required. Ideal for headless blogs and custom frontends.
descriptions.export: Export all your blog data from Hyvor Blogs as JSON at any time: posts, tags, users, and settings. Back up your blog or migrate to another platform.
descriptions.importOverview: Import your existing blog into Hyvor Blogs from a sitemap or WordPress export. Overview of supported import methods and what is migrated.
descriptions.importSitemap: Import blog posts from any platform into Hyvor Blogs using your sitemap.xml. Extract titles, content, and metadata with meta tags and CSS selectors.
descriptions.importWordpress: Migrate from WordPress to Hyvor Blogs. Export your WordPress content (WXR file) and import posts, tags, and authors with help from our support team.
